steps.text: Go to the calculator and sign in or create a studio account.

guides.title: Grey fabric costing: reed, pick, warp, weft, sizing
guides.ogTitle: Grey fabric costing: reed, pick, warp, weft, sizing
guides.description: How grey fabric costing works on an Indian powerloom mill sheet — warp weight (1825), weft weight (1693.33), sizing, and dalal / pick rate.
guides.keywords: grey fabric costing, warp weft, reed pick, sizing, powerloom, mill sheet, fabriccost STUDIO
guides.lead: The calculator uses the mill-sheet constants 1825 for warp and 1693.33 for weft.

sections.heading: Warp weight
paragraphs: Warp weight = (warp reed space × reed × 120) ÷ (1825 × warp count × L2L). Use inches for reed space and L2L. Warp cost = warp weight × warp yarn rate.

sections.heading: Weft weight
paragraphs: Weft base = (weft reed space × pick) ÷ (1693.33 × weft count). Add wastage to this base: weft weight = base × (1 + wastage% ÷ 100). Weft cost = weft weight × weft yarn rate.

sections.heading: Sizing and making cost
paragraphs: Sizing = warp weight × sizing rate. Dalal / majuri = pick × (paise per pick ÷ 100). Enter 12 for 12 paise. Warping is a flat rupee addition.

sections.heading: The final cost
paragraphs: Total = warp cost + weft cost + sizing + dalal / majuri + warping. Markups are shown separately. The calculator retains the mill sheet’s rounding rules. Built by Harshvardhan Pareek.

howTo.name: How to cost grey fabric from a mill sheet
howTo.description: Turn reed, pick, counts and rates into warp weight, weft weight, sizing and a dalal total.

steps.name: Take reed, reed space, L2L and warp count
steps.text: Compute warp weight as (reed space × reed × 120) / (1825 × warp count × L2L).

steps.name: Take pick, weft reed space, weft count and wastage
steps.text: Compute weft base as (reed space × pick) / (1693.33 × weft count), then add wastage percent on that base only.

steps.name: Apply yarn rates and sizing
steps.text: Multiply warp weight by warp rate and sizing rate. Multiply weft weight by weft rate.

steps.name: Add the dalal line
steps.text: Dalal / broker cost is pick × (majuri paise ÷ 100). 12 on that field is 12 paise (₹0.12). Add optional warping, then read the grand total.

guides.title: Powerloom fabric cost — single and multi yarn sheets
guides.ogTitle: Powerloom fabric cost — single and multi yarn sheets
guides.description: Work out powerloom fabric cost from mill-sheet values: single or multiple warp/weft, dalal / pick rate, and an editable rupee breakdown.
guides.keywords: powerloom fabric cost, powerloom grey fabric costing, multiple warp weft, dalal rate, fabriccost STUDIO
guides.lead: Choose the yarn construction that matches your fabric, then enter its reed, pick and rates.

sections.heading: Split yarns by percentage
paragraphs: Multiple Warp / Weft supports three warp and three weft yarns. Each active yarn needs a percentage, count and rate. Warp yarns also have sizing rates. Each side’s percentages must total 100%.

sections.heading: Shared costs
paragraphs: The dalal / majuri line and warping apply to the whole construction. Enter majuri in paise per pick: 12 means ₹0.12. Results include warp, weft, sizing and optional markups.

sections.heading: Voice entry
paragraphs: A compatible browser and microphone permission are required. Name a field, then speak its value. Check every value before calculating; use typed entry when speech is unavailable or inaccurate.

sections.heading: Review and export
paragraphs: Use the results page controls to review yarns and markups. Edit inputs to change a value and recalculate. Print / PDF includes the complete sheet. Built by Harshvardhan Pareek.

howTo.name: How to work out powerloom fabric cost
howTo.description: Build a powerloom grey-fabric cost from single or multiple yarns and a dalal / pick rate.

steps.name: Match the yarn mode to the quality
steps.text: Choose Single Warp for one warp and one weft, or Multiple Warp / Weft when percentages split the yarns.

steps.name: Fill construction and counts
steps.text: Enter reed, reed space, L2L, pick, warp and weft counts, and weft wastage the way the mill sheet is written.

steps.name: Fill rupee rates
steps.text: Enter warp rate, weft rate, sizing rate, majuri / pick rate in paise (12 means ₹0.12), and optional warping.

steps.name: Calculate and edit
steps.text: Read warp, weft, sizing and dalal lines, then change a field and recalculate when a rate changes.
